title: AV-8B Harriers Take Off
description: ATLANTIC OCEAN (Dec. 1, 2024) An AV-8B Harrier assigned to the "Blue Nights" of Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 365 (Reinforced), takes off from the flight deck the amphibious assault ship USS Wasp (LHD 1), Dec. 1, 2024. Wasp is conducting operations in the Atlantic Ocean as the flagship of the Amphibious Ready Group (WSP ARG)-24th Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU) Special Operations Capable (SOC). (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Keresea Illenye)
